recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If MnM still wants durable guidance about overlapping code systems in value sets, create or update the Guide to Designing Resources or another design-governance artifact outside this current build; do not introduce a combined PurposeOfUse value set in core as part of this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-27547 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. It asked for guidance on whether value sets may include nearly overlapping codes from different systems, using a proposed HL7 v3 PurposeOfUse plus ISO 14265 PurposeOfUse value set as the motivating case. The MnM resolution said to document why overlap is included and the consequences for downstream translation and UI lookup, with the approved action to add guidance to the Confluence Guide to Designing Resources.
initial_application: No source commit or current source comment explicitly mentioning FHIR-27547 was found. Current core source does not define a combined HL7-v3-plus-ISO PurposeOfUse value set: inspected active bindings point to the HL7 Terminology v3 PurposeOfUse value set, and the separate NHIN example value set says it is derived from but not compatible with the HL7 v3 code system.
additional_context: The linked security issue FHIR-24676 was later Published with a narrower resolution: rather than creating a combined overlapping value set, security PurposeOfUse bindings were loosened to example where appropriate so ISO codes can be used without forcing overlap in the base value set. Current AuditEvent and Provenance authorization elements reflect that pattern and state their security context is not restricted to the purposeOfUse value set. MnM minutes confirm the FHIR-27547 vote, and community searches found no directly relevant conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR core source was changed because the approved guidance target is external to this checkout/current build and the current core source no longer contains the overlapping PurposeOfUse value set design that triggered the issue.
